headline.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
headline.summary: Wayve has launched an $85 million employee tender offer, valuing the company at $8.5 billion. This move reflects a broader trend among AI startups utilizing such offers to attract and retain talent.

articles.title: Anthropic’s long-sidelined Fable 5 is greenlit to return
articles.summary: Anthropic has received approval from the Trump administration to restore access to its Claude Fable 5 AI model, which had been sidelined for weeks. The company announced plans to begin re-enabling access for users globally on various platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft, starting Wednesday.

articles.title: Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival
articles.summary: A researcher discovered that Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7 could be utilized to exploit vulnerabilities in the Front Gate ticketing website, allowing unauthorized access to issue tickets for major US music festivals. This breach raises significant concerns about the security of online ticketing systems.

articles.title: Start building with Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash
articles.summary: Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash have been introduced as new tools for developers, offering enhanced capabilities for building applications. These innovations aim to streamline the development process and improve performance across various platforms.

articles.title: Claude Science is Anthropic’s newest flagship product
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Science, a new AI product designed to assist in scientific research, similar to its previous offering, Claude Code, which supports software engineering. The tool can autonomously perform tasks based on concise instructions and is tailored for use by pharmaceutical executives, biotech founders, and researchers.

articles.title: The ‘Father of the Internet’ is finally retiring
articles.summary: Vinton Cerf, known as the "Father of the Internet" for his role in developing key internet protocols, will retire from his position as Google's chief internet evangelist next week. Cerf's contributions have significantly shaped the digital landscape we navigate today.

articles.title: Trump drops restrictions on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable models
articles.summary: The Trump administration has lifted restrictions on Anthropic's Mythos and Fable AI models, contributing to ongoing uncertainty in AI policymaking. This decision reflects the administration's inconsistent approach, leaving companies unsure about future regulations governing AI model releases.

articles.title: The Trump Administration Is Lifting Its Export Controls on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable AI Models
articles.summary: The Trump Administration is lifting export controls on Anthropic's advanced AI models, Mythos and Fable, after previously ordering the company to suspend access for foreign nationals. This decision marks a significant change in the administration's approach to AI export regulations.

articles.title: HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic: Multi-Hop Question Answering Corpus for Historical Research, Parliamentary Debates from the French Third Republic (1870-1940)
articles.summary: The HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic dataset is a new French-language resource for multi-hop question answering, derived from parliamentary debates and newspapers of the French Third Republic (1870-1940). Comprising 1,782 questions, it aims to facilitate complex historical reasoning and analysis by incorporating cross-source synthesis and temporal reasoning.

articles.title: Optimization Algorithms for Joint OFDM Waveform Design and RIS Configuration in 6G Networks: From Convex Relaxation to Foundation Models
articles.summary: The article surveys 78 joint OFDM-RIS optimization studies published between 2021 and 2026, addressing a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem focused on various objectives such as sum-rate maximization and energy efficiency. It highlights the lack of standardized benchmarks, making cross-paper comparisons challenging, and categorizes the surveyed works into four paradigms.

articles.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
articles.summary: The technical report titled "Xiaomi-GUI-0" discusses the development of graphical user interface (GUI) agents that utilize vision-language models to perform user tasks through various interface actions. It highlights the limitations of current training and evaluation methods, which primarily rely on offline data and simulated environments, and emphasizes the need for more realistic assessments in real-world applications.

articles.title: Modality-Driven Search with Holistic Trace Judging for ARC-AGI-2
articles.summary: The article presents a new solver for the ARC-AGI-2 benchmark, which focuses on few-shot visual reasoning tasks by treating reasoning modalities as search operators. This approach aims to enhance candidate selection by generating diverse reasoning traces across text and images, addressing the challenge of large language models producing fluent but potentially incorrect outputs.
